completion_rule: An app is factory-complete when its source bundle is generated/validated, its internal repository revision is recorded, its runtime health contract passes, and any external integration remains an explicit adapter gate. Do not convert provider rate-limit or deployment failures into application failures.
deployment_rule: Public-live is separate from code completion and requires real owned-runtime evidence. Vercel rate-limit failures are not release blockers for owned-first completion.
